author: GamingBolt
description:
Part 4 of our Resident Evil recap finally took us to Raccoon City, where we went over the events of Resident Evil 2, and Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield’s night of terrors. There are, however, still plenty of stories left to tell in Raccoon City- even before we get to Resident Evil 3, in fact. 

Here in part 4, we are going to talk about Resident Evil Outbreak, which, along with its sequel, has been a canonical but relatively less important part of the overarching Resident Evil narrative. Now though, with the upcoming Resident Evil Requiem confirmed to have several direct ties to the Outbreak games, both have increased rapidly in significance.

author: GamingBolt
description: Between the bigger world, more robust build variety, and tougher bosses, Code Vein 2 has a lot going on. Many of your strategies from the original may carry over, but there's a lot that's new. Let's go over 14 tips and tricks that will help you survive this time-travelling adventure.
title: Code Vein 2 - 14 Things It DOESN'T TELL YOU

author: GamingBolt
description:
We're less than a month away from Resident Evil Requiem's final release and the latest batch of previews has given us a lot of new information, and a lot of things to speculate about. There are so many reasons to be excited for an addition to the horror genre that seems to be quite intentional in bringing the best of what came before it to the table.

We've put together a list of the latest details that speak to that sentiment, and if you're thinking about preordering the game so you can dive into it as soon as you can, you're going to want to join us on this one. This is a Resident Evil title that looks like it could be the best one yet for the genre, and we couldn't be more delighted to take you through why we think so.
title: Resident Evil Requiem - 15 NEW Things You NEED TO KNOW Before You Pre-Order
